description: Defines the 'paging_scheduler' class responsible for scheduling paging resources in a 5G NR system, including handling paging requests, resource allocation, and scheduling logic.

classes.name: paging_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for managing paging resource scheduling, including handling paging requests, resource allocation, and scheduling logic.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Performs paging scheduling for the current slot, allocating resources as needed.

methods.name: handle_paging_information
methods.description: Processes paging information reported by upper layers for scheduling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the paging scheduler, typically called when the cell is deactivated.

methods.name: handle_pending_paging_requests
methods.description: Processes queued paging requests from upper layers.

methods.name: find_pdsch_time_resource
methods.description: Finds available PDSCH time resource for a paging request.

methods.name: get_accumulated_paging_msg_size
methods.description: Calculates total paging message size for a set of UEs scheduled at a particular slot.

methods.name: is_there_space_available_for_paging
methods.description: Checks if there is sufficient space in the resource grid for paging.

methods.name: allocate_paging
methods.description: Allocates PDSCH and PDCCH resources for paging UEs.

methods.name: fill_paging_grant
methods.description: Fills the paging grant with resource allocation details.

methods.name: is_paging_opportunity
methods.description: Determines if the current slot is suitable for paging for a specific UE.
